captions.detailed: A surveillance blimp featuring a long, segmented grey envelope with thin structural bands. Underneath the envelope, a small white cylindrical sensor gondola is mounted, which has dark-colored vectoring pylons extending to the sides to hold two black engine nacelles with multi-blade propellers. The tail assembly consists of a vertical stabilizer with a movable rudder and two horizontal stabilizers with movable elevators. The propellers spin continuously, while the rudder, elevators, and engine pods pivot on their respective axes.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a surveillance blimp with a long, segmented grey envelope, a small white gondola underneath, and side-mounted engine pylons carrying rotatable engine nacelles. Include a tail assembly with a vertical rudder and horizontal elevators, setting up articulations for propeller rotation, rudder yaw, elevator pitch, and engine pod vectoring.
captions.factory: Construct the main envelope by lofting or revolving a series of profile circles into a segmented, streamlined body. Model the gondola using a rounded box or horizontal cylinder, and attach thin cylindrical struts to support the engine nacelles. Create the engine nacelles and propellers using cylinders and thin box blades, and construct the tail fins using extruded sketches. Define revolute joints for the rudder and elevators, a continuous rotation joint for the propellers, and a revolute pivot for the engine pods.
